newsitem.title: LATVIA: HANSABANK-LATVIJA GETS RUSSIAN T-BILL BOOST.
newsitem.headline: HANSABANK-LATVIJA GETS RUSSIAN T-BILL BOOST.

text.p: Hansabank-Latvija, the Latvian banking arm of Estonia's Hansapank , said on Monday that the gains in its seven month and July profits were helped by returns on Russian state debt.
The bank earlier reported a seven-month profit of 1.02 million lats, which it said beat the forecast profit by 700,000 lats. Its July profit was 338,142 lats, up 200,000 lats on June.
"The greater part of the bank's profit came from successful interbank trading in Russian state debt," the bank said in a statement.
It said its total income over the seven months was 3.9 million lats, 23 percent higher than planned, and that its interest income was 2.6 million lats, three percent higher than forecast.
The bank's credit portfolio came to 21.7 million lats.
